scientific_question: Does the full NABU interaction model add reproducible hidden-combination selection value beyond additive and raw-pair baselines?
dataset_policy: Use an existing benign combinatorial landscape CSV. Outcome labels may be read only by the split/evaluation stage. Candidate scoring receives visible labels and hidden mutation identities only.

split.canonical_id: mutation tokens sorted by residue position and joined with ':'

eligibility: Hidden variants with 3-5 substitutions; every component must occur in visible data; at least one mutation pair must occur in visible data.

fixed_hyperparameters.b5_consensus_rule: mean of standardized additive and raw-pair scores

pre_reveal_freeze: Freeze Top-50 candidate IDs and predicted scores for every arm plus SHA-256 before hidden outcomes are evaluated.
primary_metrics: Top-50 enrichment for hidden top 1 percent

required: B5 beats B3_RAW_PAIR on at least 3 of 4 design-selection metrics: Top1 percentile, Top5 mean percentile, Top50 enrichment, normalized regret
success_gate.interpretation: PASS supports added selection value beyond raw pairwise. FAIL means current full NABU has not demonstrated that added value on this test.

anti_retuning: No threshold, aggregation, split, candidate budget, or success-gate changes after reveal. Any change becomes V8 on fresh data.
boundary: Computational benchmark only; not laboratory validation and not de novo protein creation.
